mapper.sql: select release_id, version, channel, os, arch, file_name, file_path, file_size, sha512, rollout_percent, min_version, release_notes, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from itm_release
mapper.select: where status = '0' and channel = #{channel} and os = #{os} and arch = #{arch}
mapper.insert: insert into itm_release (version, channel, os, arch, file_name, file_path, file_size, sha512, rollout_percent, min_version, release_notes, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{version}, #{channel}, #{os}, #{arch}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{sha512}, #{rolloutPercent}, #{minVersion}, #{releaseNotes}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from itm_release where release_id in #{id}
